## Theses and internships

Looking for a master's thesis or internship? Send us an email with your CV and we will get back to you.

```{=html}
<p class="contact-email"><a id="contact-email" href="#"><i class="bi bi-envelope-fill"></i> <span>Email us</span></a></p>
<noscript>Please turn on JavaScript to see our email address, or find us on LinkedIn above.</noscript>
<script>
// The address is not in the page until a person clicks "Email us": it is put
// together at that moment, then the email app opens. Programs that collect
// addresses from websites read the page but do not click, so they never see it.
(function () {
  var link = document.getElementById("contact-email");
  link.addEventListener("click", function (e) {
    if (link.dataset.shown === "1") return;
    e.preventDefault();
    var address = "demonlab.lund" + "@" + "gmail.com";
    link.href = "mailto:" + address + "?subject=" +
      encodeURIComponent("Master's thesis or internship application");
    link.querySelector("span").textContent = address;
    link.dataset.shown = "1";
    window.location.href = link.href;
  });
})();
</script>
```

In your email, please tell us:

- your name, university and degree level,
- what you would like to apply for (for example a master's thesis or an internship),
- when you would like to start and for how long,
- a few lines about your interests, with your CV attached as a PDF.

For PhD and postdoc positions, please apply through our [Openings](news.html#openings) page. Thank you!
